property_summary: After any successful fallback call in a block, a second fallback call in the same block must revert because pastBlockTime was updated to the current timestamp; the mutant skips updating pastBlockTime on payout blocks (block.number % 15 == 0), so the second same-block call succeeds instead of reverting.

For any admissible scenario (timestamp >= 1, block number a multiple of 15), a payout-triggering fallback call must have already updated pastBlockTime before the payout transfer executes, so no re-entrant fallback call can succeed within that call; the mutant assigns pastBlockTime only after the transfer, letting a re-entrant call in the same block succeed.
